semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Huake Engineering India Pvt. Ltd. specializes in clean room design and construction, which is essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Huake Engineering India Pvt. Ltd. provides comprehensive clean room solutions, including design, construction, and maintenance services tailored for industries such as microelectronics and semiconductors. Their expertise encompasses a range of clean room classifications and purification equipment essential for maintaining the required environments in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Design and construction of clean rooms from Class 10 to Class 300,000
System debugging and parameter testing for clean room environments
Production of purification equipment including high-efficiency filters and air supply vents

regional_presence.India: Huake has established a subsidiary in India to support its clean room services and solutions.
